_comment: Hearthbound: BWG coverage for nova_structures:collections/snowy_structures, which dungeons-and-taverns-3.0.3.f.jar ships as an explicit biome list (terralith/biomesoplenty/byg/RU named one by one), so BWG generated none of these structures.
